component.name: Hypr Control
component.summary: Configure Hyprland and Omarchy from a native GTK application

description.p: Hypr Control provides a graphical control center for common Hyprland and Omarchy settings, including native display layouts and automatic display profiles, appearance, input, idle behavior, shortcuts, and raw configuration files.
Configuration changes are transactional, backed up, validated with Hyprland, and reverted automatically when validation fails.

screenshot.caption: Live Hyprland and Omarchy status with common actions
Appearance presets and detailed window effects
Power controls and the chronological idle timeline

description.p: Adds native display arrangement, quick display modes, safe previews, stable setup memory, and automatic hotplug switching.
Adds transactional saves, external-change protection, search, appearance presets, shortcut capture, backup restoration, and a corrected idle timeline.
